_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleya {player_id} long Tri-Pleya Tik Tac Toe.
Simbol bilong yu em '{symbol}'.
Yu mekim muvmen tasol putim simbol bilong yu long bord 5x5 i mekim lain bilong fo.
Lain i ken bekwinim horizontal, vertikal, o diagonal.
Sampim muvmen bilong yu long fomat '[4]' i mekim sel 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I no orait long format bilong move. Yusim "[cell]" we sel i 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Sel bilong invalid: {cell}. Mas bekwinim 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Man {player_id} i mekim wanpela samting em i no stret long en.

game_action.placed: Pleya {player_id} putim simbol bilong em ({symbol}) long filid ({row}, {col}).
